To the Firesmith clan, crafting unparalleled weapons is both their talent's calling and a lifelong curse.

Ever since the arrival of the liberated Firesmith Clan in the world of Warforge, their skills bloomed to the extremes while also becoming tainted with the aura of Destruction.

The dazzling light of the furnace, the sparks of metal clashing, and the long-lasting forging process can turn raw ore into a fine weapon, but can also gradually strip the firesmith of their eyesight. One day, at the bottom of a volcano, Foy found a deposit of rare obsidian flame crystal. From this, he carefully polished a pair of protective goggles, which transformed the fierce sparks of fire into pale-white silhouettes. However, the greedy smith was unable to fully escape his cursed fate either, burning everything he was into cinders in the ultimate fire.

Foy deemed the Antimatter Legion in the Warforge as the raw materials for his creations, and himself as the rising flame.

The "Astral Trendible" draw event is now available.

▌ Event Details
During the event, Trailblazers can use Trendible Vouchers to draw.
● During this Astral Trendible draw event, the obtainable Imagea editions include: Classic Edition Chimera, Classic Edition Kitty Furb, Collector's Edition Chimera, and Collector's Edition Kitty Furb. Details for each edition can be viewed in the item pool.

▌ Astral Trendible Draw Event Details
■ Draw Rates
In this period's Astral Trendible draw event, the chances to obtain each edition are as follows:
● During the event, the base chance to obtain a Classic Edition Chimera is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>88.800%</unbreak></color>, and the consolidated chance (including the guarantee) is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>70.443%</unbreak></color>. Any one Classic Edition Chimera Imagea has equal chance to be drawn.
● During the event, the base chance to obtain a Classic Edition Kitty Furb is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>10.000%</unbreak></color>, and the consolidated chance (including the guarantee) is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>22.704%</unbreak></color>. Any one Classic Edition Kitty Furb Imagea has equal chance to be drawn. You are guaranteed to obtain a Classic Edition Kitty Furb Imagea or a Collector's Edition (either Chimera or Kitty Furb) within a maximum of <color=#f29e38ff>6</color> draws. The chance to obtain a Classic Edition Kitty Furb via this guarantee is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>98.800%</unbreak></color>, and for the Collector's Edition (either Chimera or Kitty Furb), it is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>1.200%</unbreak></color>.
● During the event, the base chance to obtain a Collector's Edition (either Chimera or Kitty Furb) is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>1.200%</unbreak></color>, and the consolidated chance (including the guarantee) is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>6.853%</unbreak></color>. You are guaranteed to obtain a Collector's Edition (either Chimera or Kitty Furb) within a maximum of <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>24</unbreak></color> draws.
● During the event, the base chance to obtain a Collector's Edition Chimera is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>0.960%</unbreak></color>, and the consolidated chance (including the guarantee) is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>4.311%</unbreak></color>. Any one Collector's Edition Chimera Imagea has equal chance to be drawn.
● During the event, the base chance to obtain a Collector's Edition Kitty Furb is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>0.240%</unbreak></color>, and the consolidated chance (including the guarantee) is <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>2.542%</unbreak></color>. Any one Collector's Edition Kitty Furb Imagea has equal chance to be drawn. A Collector's Edition Kitty Furb Imagea is guaranteed within a maximum of <color=#f29e38ff>4</color> draws in which a Collector's Edition is obtained.

▌ Collector's Edition Details
● After obtaining a Collector's Edition Astral Imagea, Trailblazers can freely switch its appearance between "Classic Skin" and "Collector's Skin" for display in the game.

▌ Imagea Trade Details
● Trailblazers can use their owned Astral Imageas for Imagea trades with their friends.
● Astral Imageas can only be traded with others of the same edition: A Classic Edition Chimera Imagea can only be exchanged for another Classic Edition Chimera Imagea, a Classic Edition Kitty Furb Imagea can only be exchanged for another Classic Edition Kitty Furb Imagea, a Collector's Edition Chimera Imagea can only be exchanged for another Collector's Edition Chimera Imagea, and a Collector's Edition Kitty Furb Imagea can only be exchanged for another Collector's Edition Kitty Furb Imagea.

▌ Imagea Reclamation Details
● When Trailblazers possess duplicate Classic Edition Astral Imageas, the 2nd and any subsequent duplicate Classic Edition Astral Imageas can be reclaimed as Wishing Stardust.
● When the reclamation conditions are met, each Classic Edition Kitty Furb can be reclaimed into <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>60</unbreak></color> Wishing Stardust, and each Classic Edition Chimera can be reclaimed into <color=#f29e38ff><unbreak>30</unbreak></color> Wishing Stardust.
● The Collector's Edition cannot be reclaimed into Wishing Stardust.
